# Maple AI

> Done-for-you AI systems for Canadian small businesses. Maple AI is a one-person consultancy in Orangeville, Ontario that builds, runs and maintains AI automation, chatbots and Claude Code implementations for owner-operated businesses. The person who scopes the work is the person who builds it.

Maple AI is run by Shawn Lowry. Unusually for the category, the systems described here are in live production for paying clients, not demos: a 24/7 AI intake agent booking jobs into a tree service's field-service software, a customer intelligence platform scoring 12,373 records for an ID card distributor, and an AI phone agent handling roughly 100 calls a month for a family law practice.

Contact: sales@mapleai.io · +1-905-999-3465 · Orangeville, Ontario, Canada
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 Eastern
Service area: in person across Ontario, remote across Canada

## Claude Code

Maple AI is one of the few Canadian consultancies focused on implementing Claude Code and Claude Cowork for non-developer small and medium businesses. We install, configure, integrate, train and support.

- [Claude Code for Small Business](https://mapleai.io/claude-code/): What Claude Code is, how a non-technical business actually uses it, and what implementation involves
- [Claude Code for Non-Developers](https://mapleai.io/claude-code/for-non-developers): Plain-English guide covering what it is, what you can build, and how to start without the terminal
- [Claude Code vs Codex CLI](https://mapleai.io/claude-code/vs-codex): Honest 2026 comparison on quality, speed and pricing, with a recommendation for SMBs
- [Claude Code Training and Workshops](https://mapleai.io/claude-code/training): Half-day and full-day hands-on training built around a team's real work

## Who this is for

Owner-operated businesses, typically 2 to 50 employees, where the owner is still close to the work. Common verticals: trades and contractors, law firms, real estate, healthcare administration, distribution and professional services. Buyers are usually non-technical.

## How engagements run

Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute automation audit, with no commitment. Builds are quoted after discovery rather than billed hourly, so there are no hourly surprises and no scope creep. Standing practice on client systems is read-only access first, written approval before anything writes back, and no client data used for training.
